demo_message: Demonstration: check the HTTPS service and the certificate it presents.
footer: Message generated by {{app_name}}. All dates are in UTC.

actions.expiry: Coordinate renewal with the certificate contacts and check ownership, operational dates, and affected services in the registry.
actions.expired: Urgently coordinate renewal and restoration of affected services. Check progress with the technical contacts.
actions.escalation: Contact those responsible for renewal, clarify outstanding work, and update operational deadlines.
actions.certificate: Coordinate delivery and installation of the signed certificate. Check the completion checklist before closing the renewal.
actions.monitor: Assign the service investigation to a technical contact and track resolution. An unexpected certificate requires explicit review.
actions.recovered: Confirm recovery with the technical contacts and update the incident’s operational status in the registry.

actions.expiry: Plan renewal with the technical contact and confirm request, delivery, and installation dates.
actions.expired: Urgently contact the technical contact to renew the certificate and assess the effect on services.
actions.escalation: Confirm the renewal plan with the technical contact and report any obstacles or delays.
actions.certificate: Agree an installation window for the signed certificate with the technical contact and confirm completion.
actions.monitor: Arrange a service check with the technical contact and assess the business impact.
actions.recovered: Confirm with the technical contact that the service is operational again and check any remaining impact.

actions.expiry: Prepare renewal and schedule installation on the affected services. After installation, verify the chain, names, and fingerprint of the certificate presented.
actions.expired: Urgently renew and install the certificate. Check every affected service and record installation evidence.
actions.escalation: Check request and installation progress, resolve blockers, and update the renewal case.
actions.certificate: Install the signed certificate and the required chain. Verify the fingerprint presented by every service and complete the renewal checklist.
actions.monitor: Check reachability, the TLS handshake, the chain, and the presented fingerprint. Compare the result with the registry before approving a different certificate.
actions.recovered: Confirm reachability and TLS validation, check the certificate presented, and record the outcome.

actions.expiry: Contact the certificate owners to agree renewal and installation dates.
actions.expired: Urgently notify the certificate contacts and agree renewal and service checks.
actions.escalation: Contact those responsible for renewal to clarify outstanding work.
actions.certificate: Agree delivery and installation of the signed certificate with the technical contacts.
actions.monitor: Notify the service contacts and arrange a technical investigation of the issue.
actions.recovered: Agree confirmation of recovery and incident closure with the service contacts.

expiry_30.label: 30-day reminder
expiry_30.subject: HTTPS certificate {{common_name}}: 30-day expiry reminder
expiry_30.text: This HTTPS certificate has reached the 30-day reminder threshold. Confirm that the renewal request and installation work are scheduled.

expiry_15.label: 15-day reminder
expiry_15.subject: HTTPS certificate {{common_name}}: 15-day expiry reminder
expiry_15.text: This HTTPS certificate has reached the 15-day reminder threshold. Check renewal progress and ensure an installation window is available.

expiry_2.label: 2-day reminder
expiry_2.subject: Urgent: HTTPS certificate {{common_name}} has reached the 2-day expiry threshold
expiry_2.text: This HTTPS certificate has reached the 2-day reminder threshold. Renewal and installation need immediate attention.

expired.label: Expired certificate
expired.subject: HTTPS certificate expired: {{common_name}}
expired.text: The validity period of this HTTPS certificate has ended. Services presenting it may fail TLS validation.

expiry.label: Custom expiry reminder
expiry.subject: HTTPS certificate {{common_name}}: {{threshold}}-day expiry threshold
expiry.text: This HTTPS certificate has reached its custom reminder threshold. Check the remaining days and the dates below.

escalation.label: Renewal escalation
escalation.subject: HTTPS certificate renewal escalation: {{common_name}}
escalation.text: The escalation period since the first recorded reminder has elapsed for this certificate. Check outstanding renewal and installation work.

certificate.label: Signed certificate available
certificate.subject: Signed HTTPS certificate for {{common_name}}: valid until {{not_after}}
certificate.text: The signed HTTPS certificate for {{common_name}} is attached. The attachment contains public certificates only and does not include private keys. Delivery does not confirm installation.

unreachable.label: Service unreachable
unreachable.subject: HTTPS service unreachable: {{service_url}}
unreachable.text: The automatic check could not reach the HTTPS service. A DNS lookup or TCP connection failure may prevent certificate retrieval. See the original technical details.

tls_error.label: TLS connection error
tls_error.subject: TLS connection failed: {{service_url}}
tls_error.text: The connection to the service did not complete the TLS handshake successfully. The certificate may not have been retrieved, or the session may have been interrupted.

changed.label: Certificate differs from registry
changed.subject: HTTPS certificate changed: {{service_url}}
changed.text: The service presents a certificate whose fingerprint differs from the registry’s expected fingerprint. This may be an installed renewal or an unexpected change; the new certificate is not approved automatically.

verification_error.label: Certificate validation failed
verification_error.subject: HTTPS certificate validation failed: {{service_url}}
verification_error.text: The service certificate was retrieved, but TLS trust validation failed. Check names, validity, and the certificate chain before accepting the result.

error.label: Monitoring error
error.subject: HTTPS service check error: {{service_url}}
error.text: The automatic HTTPS service check ended with an error. Read the original technical details and repeat the check after identifying the cause.

recovered.label: Service recovered
recovered.subject: HTTPS service recovered: {{service_url}}
recovered.text: The latest check indicates that the HTTPS service is operational again. Technical recovery does not automatically close the incident management task.
